description: MLIT provides zonal trip-generation and attraction totals from person-trip surveys for the Tokyo, Kinki and Chukyo metropolitan areas. The metadata distinguishes publication years from survey years: the retained releases draw on Tokyo 2008, Kinki 2000 and 2010, and Chukyo 2001 and 2011 surveys. Zone polygons carry trip totals by purpose and representative mode of transport. Tokyo and Chukyo use basic planning zones, while Kinki uses small zones. These aggregated travel-demand observations can supply inputs to transport-demand models. The different survey years and zoning schemes must be preserved when comparing regions. This resource contains zonal generation and attraction totals; the separate S05-b product records flows between zones. The provider supplies GML and Shapefile metadata and download links. Access is free under the National Land Numerical Information terms; the page restricts this edition to non-commercial use. Only the catalogue metadata was reviewed. Dataset files and their current contents were not downloaded. The related parent record is the MLIT National Land Numerical Information catalogue.
